en: Hey, hey! Kaede! Can you do me a favor?

<CLT=cltMIND>I already have a bad feeling about whatever
this "favor" is...

Don't gimme that face! I wouldn't ask you to do
something crazy, like kill someone!

K-Kokichi! Didn't I tell you before that some
things are best left unsaid...?

Oh, soooorry! I know I said I wouldn't say
anything, but that was a lie, too!

Anyway, about this favor I need... Can you use
your talent for me?
My talent?

Yup! Will you, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>, work
with me after we escape?

Oh, but...you'd work with me once you've become
the former <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
What do you mean?

After you graduate high school, you'll probably
go on to represent Japan as a pianist, right?

If that happens, you'll be flying all over the
world for concert tours and stuff, right?

World tours as a pianist? Me?
I don't know about that...

Why? I know you could do it! And you'd be
so popular, too!

That's why I want you to become an agent
for my organization.
Wh-What the—?

As a famous pianist, you'd be able to enter
any country without arousing suspicion, yeah?

You'd probably meet important figures from
different countries, too! It'd be amazing!

I think your imagination is running wild,
Kokichi...

But I just know that'll happen, okay?
So, Kaede...let's make a deal.

Join my organization, and together we'll do as
we please to all the stupid plebs in this world.

Let's sit on top of the world and look down
on everyone else...

And if we just wanna watch the world burn?
That's fine, too! We'll light the whole thing up!

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL> and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate
Pianist<CLT=cltNORMAL> joining forces sounds pretty sweet, huh?
...What the hell are you talking about?
Huh?

You claim to be the supreme leader of some
evil organization...

But that's just a lie, isn't it? I mean, does this
organization of yours even exist?
Nee-heehee... True, I am a liar.

But you've fallen for my lies plenty of times.
Why are you so certain this is another lie?
Why...? Because it's common sense.

There's no way your evil organization exists, and
it's crazy to think you're some supreme leader.

Common sense, huh? Common sense, le sens
commun, el sentido comun, joshiki...

So many words that mean "common sense"...
but who decides which one is right?

Why are you so sure that your idea of <CLT=cltSTRONG>common
sense<CLT=cltNORMAL> is the right one?
Huh...?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Initiative<CLT=cltNORMAL> chose me to receive the
title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

I'm the real deal, hand-picked by the government.
What does your <CLT=cltSTRONG>common sense<CLT=cltNORMAL> think about that?
That's true, but...

But you think I'm not a supreme leader, right?
Because that's what your <CLT=cltSTRONG>common sense<CLT=cltNORMAL> says.

It's funny... Is your <CLT=cltSTRONG>common sense<CLT=cltNORMAL> really so
similar to everyone else's <CLT=cltSTRONG>common sense<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Is what you believe to be <CLT=cltSTRONG>right<CLT=cltNORMAL> based on your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>common sense<CLT=cltNORMAL> also <CLT=cltSTRONG>right<CLT=cltNORMAL> for everyone else?
S-Stop screwing around!
Uh-ohhh! Kaede yelled at me!

A-Anyway, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Initiative<CLT=cltNORMAL> should've
given you the title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Liar<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

Nee-heehee... Maybe it should have!
I am a liar, after all!

But y'know I'm only saying this cuz I actually
care about you, right Kaede?

You can keep thinking like that, but don't come
crying back to me when things don't go your way.

Mind your own business!
And I refuse to be your agent!
Maaan, what a shame.

<CLT=cltMIND>He didn't sound too upset about that... How far
is he willing to go just to mess with people?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After parting ways with Kokichi, I returned
to my room.
